name: Impurrfect Furtopia!
source:
A son of God who wants to be a dog, a Shepherd who bears sin, a Papillon who is a duchess, a Samoyed who wants to be a cat, a Somali who has committed an taboo, and a blood monster in the shape of a cat. 

The sins piled up finally culminated in the wrath of the gods.

When the god of genesis, the ruler of cosmos, descends, the end of everything begins.

What is the answer they will arrive at after many sacrifices and hardships?

[From [url=https://i-am-rawfish.itch.io/impurrfect-furtopia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
想要成为狗的上帝之子、背负罪孽的牧羊人、想要成为公爵夫人的蝴蝶犬、想要成为猫的萨摩耶、犯了禁忌的索马里人、以及猫形的血怪。

罪孽不断累积，终于在众神的愤怒中达到了顶峰。

当创世神，宇宙的主宰者降临，一切的终结就开始了。

经过重重牺牲和磨难后，他们会得到怎样的答案？

[来自[url=https://i-am-rawfish.itch.io/impurrfect-furtopia]Itch.io[/url]]
